summary.plain: A small hexagon of radio-antenna stations that once sat on the surface of the Ross Ice Shelf, each one a self-contained listening post for neutrino signals.
summary.technical: ARIANNA Hexagonal Radio Array: surface radio-detection stations on the Ross Ice Shelf, from a single 2009 prototype to a 7-8 station pilot array (2014-2019), now decommissioned.

technology.quote: eight ARIANNA stations are taking data on the Ross Ice-shelf, in a prototype experiment called the Hexagonal Radio Array (HRA)
technology.value: Surface-deployed radio antenna stations detecting Askaryan-effect radio pulses from neutrino interactions in the ice below
